name: Limbo
description: A woman in her mid thirties, a blazing limbo-contest MC who sings high-energy soca.
build: A curvy, strong adult build: rounded shoulders, a defined waist, full hips, and strong arms and legs of ordinary length, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Deep brown skin, dark brown eyes under arched black brows, a broad nose, high round cheekbones and full lips.
hair: Big voluminous black curls piled high on the head, with one large bold orange-and-yellow hibiscus flower tucked above the character-left ear.
outfit: A bright tropical wrap top in sunflower yellow tied at the midriff with short puffed sleeves; a high-waisted knee-length skirt in bold turquoise with wide horizontal bands of orange and green; a wide gold waist chain; big gold hoop earrings; gold flat sandals.
performance_style: Hype MC stance: feet wide, hips cocked to one side, weight on the character-left leg. The character-right hand open and raised high overhead calling the crowd; the character-left hand open on the hip, fingers visible. Head up, a huge bright open smile.
location: A beach bar limbo contest in late afternoon: warm sand running to the bottom of the frame, a bamboo limbo bar on two poles, a thatched tiki bar with strings of lanterns behind, palm trees and a gold-orange sky.
recognition_cues: a big orange-and-yellow hibiscus above one ear
a turquoise skirt banded orange and green
palette: gold waist chain, hoops and sandals #D4A83A / #8E6E1E / #F2D278
avoid: a bikini or bare midriff beyond the tie

sing.intent: Soca vocal loop: the mic in the character-right hand at the mouth, she wines her hips side to side and waves the character-left hand open overhead on the chorus, then returns to the MC stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief startle at a loud beach sound: the shoulders jump, the torso draws back and both open hands rise to chest height, then she settles back into the opening stance. No opponent, strike or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: step the feet a little wider, bring the character-left forearm across the chest with the character-right hand open at the hip, and hold a steady grounded finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: she dances in wining her hips, the character-right hand waving overhead, and lands in the MC stance.
